item.title: A lonely day leads to a college poetry prize
item.description: The Academy of American Poets gives prizes to university and college students. One of them is Lauren Chumbley.

item.title: Spinning the Oscar nominees for Best Original Song
item.description: It’s “El Mal” from the 2024 film “Emilia Perez" won the Oscar for Best Original Song in 2025.

item.title: After his parents’ killing, Colin Hortman is working through grief
item.description: The Minnesota legislature opened its session this week with a special ceremony for Rep. Melissa Hortman and her husband Mark, who were victims of a political assassination eight months ago.

item.title: AG Campbell asks SJC to toss out DiZoglio lawsuit on auditing the Legislature
item.description: In a filing with the SJC, the state's attorney general argues she is the "gatekeeper empowered to determine when, if ever, the Commonwealth’s intragovernmental legal disputes require judicial resolution."

item.title: Boston's fare-free bus program extended through June
item.description: MBTA bus routes 23, 28 and 29, which serve Dorchester, Mattapan and Roxbury, will remain fare-free through June after the city of Boston announced an expansion of the COVID-era program.

item.title: Reggae the seal uses rubber ducks for daily enrichment training at Boston aquarium
item.description: When 33-year-old Atlantic harbor seal Reggae plays fetch with the rubber duck, he’s practicing memory, problem-solving and focus — skills trainers say are essential to keeping animals in human care mentally and physically engaged.

item.title: Rümeysa Öztürk completes doctorate at Tufts nearly a year after harrowing ICE arrest
item.description: The Turkish national and Tufts University student was swept off the streets of Somerville last year by masked immigration agents. In a social media post this week, she announced she's completed her doctorate from Tufts’ Department of Child Study and Human Development.

item.title: Why you can't get that jingle out of your head
item.description: We all know jingles – those catchy tunes that have advertised products for decades from candy to car insurance. But how do they work, and more importantly, are they having a comeback?

item.title: Here's the latest forecast on the blizzard arriving Sunday night in New England
item.description: A blizzard is on the way to New England, bringing 1 to 2 feet of snow, power outages, damaging wind and coastal flooding.

item.title: Repost: Should I Stay Or Go?
item.description: This episode was originally released on September 9, 2016. In this favorite episode from the archives, The Sugars bring you another "Rapid Fire" episode, where they give brief answers to a handful of letters that are all centered around a theme. The theme for this episode is "stay or go" -- people who have a voice in their head telling them to leave their relationship, but who aren't sure it's the right move.
